name: grid-rect
title: Rectangular photo grid
description: A wall of photo cards ripples in from the middle card, then the camera pulls back, trucks across and pushes in on a new card.

props.name: photos
props.doc: Photo file names inside public/photos, in order. Items take them in turn and repeat when there are more items than photos.

props.name: caption
props.doc: Small line at the bottom left. Empty for none.

props.name: showHud
props.doc: Show the caption and the counter.

props.name: aperture
props.doc: Depth of field: blur, in px, of a card one focus distance away from the focus plane. 0 keeps everything sharp.

props.name: drift
props.doc: Handheld drift on the camera, as a multiple of the default (about 0.4 degrees and 6 px). 0 for a locked-off camera.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius of the cards, px.

props.name: colors.ground
props.doc: Frame edge.

props.name: colors.ground2
props.doc: Frame centre, slightly lighter.

props.name: colors.ink
props.doc: Caption type.

props.name: colors.edge
props.doc: Hairline round every card, or 'none' (the default) for clean edges.

props.name: cols
props.doc: Cards across.

props.name: rows
props.doc: Cards down.

props.name: cardWidth
props.doc: Card width, world px (1:1 at the focal distance).

props.name: cardHeight
props.doc: Card height, world px.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Space between cards, world px.

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames of delay per card of distance from the middle, for the ripple in.

props.name: startDistance
props.doc: Eye distance of the opening shot (a single card fills the frame at about 1000).

props.name: endDistance
props.doc: Eye distance of the wide shot.

props.name: orbit
props.doc: Degrees the camera turns about the wall for the wide shot and the truck.

props.name: truck
props.doc: World px the camera slides sideways for the last move.

props.name: tilt
props.doc: Degrees the camera looks down on the wall in the wide shot.

props.name: hold
props.doc: Frames the opening shot holds before the pull back.

props.name: heroCol
props.doc: Columns from the middle of the second hero.

props.name: heroRow
props.doc: Rows from the middle of the second hero.

props.name: motionBlur
props.doc: Camera motion blur shutter in frames, used while the camera moves fast. 0 turns it off.
